intentional_regression.first_run_summary: The intentional prompt regression reached the verifier and blocked regression case e-001 with 1/5 passes. Other regression cases also blocked in the same run.
intentional_regression.second_run_summary: After reverting the intentional prompt instruction, e-001 returned to 5/5. The run still failed because regression case e-002 passed 3/5 and blocked CI.
intentional_regression.explanation: The first run demonstrates the eval suite catching the intentional regression. The second run shows the selected behavior returned for e-001, but also surfaced a non-infrastructure failure in e-002; per the handout, the same commit should not be rerun just to chase a passing result.
